verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for remote-desktop software, so the axis applies. The evidence never shows AnyDesk's own client or server source published under an open license. The only open-source item is an auxiliary Python module for the REST API, which is an adjacent developer tool, not the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
